summary: Second generator test, same scribe, new stock rooms. Practice evaluation 18 of 22; it fails F-001, F-006, F-013 and F-020. It reproduces F-011 (0.0316, p = 0.005 against the across-page shuffle) and F-014 (0.680 against the floor 0.667), both missed by my first procedure at 17/22 on the hidden pages; the mechanism is a stock of forms that are locally frequent and globally rare -- a three-page running list, and the once-only forms of the part being copied taken up once each. It gives back F-013 (2.19 against a ceiling of 2.10) and F-001 (9.0 against 10), and F-007 and F-021 are held by one dial that pulls them apart. F-020 stays at the null.
